evolved.criteria.page_oncall: Send a phone page to the on-call engineer. Never choose this when severity is "sev3".
evolved.criteria.create_ticket: File a ticket in the team's backlog queue. Never choose this when customers are being hurt -- severity is "sev1", or severity is "sev2" on a tier1 service.
evolved.criteria.auto_remediate: Run the alert's automated remediation script. Only choose this when the blast radius is small -- service_tier is "tier3", or service_tier is "tier2" with a sev3 symptom. Never choose this when service_tier is "tier1". Never choose this when known_runbook is "no".
evolved.criteria.rollback_deploy: Revert the service to the previously deployed build. Never choose this when recent_deploy is "no".
evolved.criteria.suppress: Silence the alert and record no follow-up work. When duplicate_of_open_incident is "no", choose page_oncall instead of this. Never choose this when duplicate_of_open_incident is "no".
